description: FREE, no account needed. Answers "what would it cost to find me N businesses, and what data comes with each one". Returns an exact cost in tokens broken down by stage (search, enrichment, contact discovery; one new lead costs one token), and when the user's account is connected its balance and the maximum businesses affordable right now, and the full list of data points each lead arrives with. THIS is the tool to use when a user asks what Lyre Leads can get them. Do NOT use count_saved_leads for that question: Lyre Leads generates leads on demand from a live Google Maps search and does not sell access to a stored pile of them, so a count of what an account already holds is not a measure of what is available.

include_contacts.description: Also find the named contacts at each business on the open web and verify their mailboxes. Default false. 2 tokens per person found, verification included.

lead_count.description: How many businesses the user wants found (1-100000)
